item.title: Trump, Zelenskyy claim major progress on Ukraine-Russia peace deal; End of war possible?
item.description: US President Donald Trump and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy held a crucial meeting in Florida to discuss a possible peace deal between Ukraine and Russia. Zelenskyy said there is 90% agreement on a proposed peace plan, while Trump indicated a deal could be reached within weeks if conditions remain favorable.

item.title: Southern Mexico train derailment kills 13, injures dozens; Click for details
item.description: A tragic train derailment in southern Mexico’s Oaxaca state has killed 13 people and injured 98 others. The Interoceanic Train, carrying 241 passengers and 9 crew members, derailed near Nizanda town, halting rail traffic. Rescue teams and federal authorities rushed to assist victims, while investigations are underway to determine the cause.

item.title: SC takes cognizance of Aravalli definition; 3-judge bench to hear mining case
item.description: Chief Justice of India (CJI) Justice Surya Kant will preside over the vacation bench hearing the Aravalli case. A three-judge bench will hear the matter on Monday.

item.title: Major cities see drop in Gold, Silver falls to Rs 2,50,900 per Kg; Check rates here
item.description: Gold prices in India have eased slightly on Monday, with 24-carat gold trading at ₹1,41,360 per 10 grams in Delhi and 22-carat at ₹1,29,590. Major cities including Mumbai, Chennai, Kolkata, Pune, and Bengaluru saw similar trends. International gold hit $4,530.42 per ounce.

item.title: EOW raids 20 locations in Chhattisgarh Bharatmala scam; ₹43 crore irregularities uncovered
item.description: It is alleged that officials and middlemen embezzled crores of rupees by manipulating the compensation amount meant for farmers. The amount involved in this scam is estimated to be around Rs 43 crore.

item.title: Uttar Pradesh closes schools up to 12th grade amid severe cold and fog
item.description: Severe cold and dense fog continue to grip Uttar Pradesh, breaking 13-year temperature records in cities like Meerut. All schools up to 12th grade, including ICSE, CBSE, and UP Board, remain closed until January 1. Low visibility due to fog has disrupted traffic, while residents struggle with freezing temperatures.

item.title: Markets End Lower in Holiday-Shortened Week; Dilip Buildcon, NBCC, Apollo Micro in focus
item.description: The BSE Sensex closed 367 points lower, slipping 0.4%, while the NSE Nifty50 declined by 99 points, also down 0.4%. Persistent selling pressure in IT and auto stocks, along with Sensex expiry-related volatility, weighed on investor sentiment.

item.title: SC to hear CBI plea against Kuldeep Sengar’s life sentence suspension
item.description: The Supreme Court will hear CBI’s plea challenging the Delhi High Court’s suspension of expelled BJP leader Kuldeep Singh Sengar’s life sentence in the 2017 Unnao rape case. The victim’s family and women’s activists have protested the suspension, citing public outrage and safety concerns.

item.title: Codeine Cough Syrup Case: Six more arrested in Varanasi and Mirzapur
item.description: It has been found that Swapnil Kesari, Dinesh Kumar Yadav, and Ashish Yadav opened three shell pharma companies with the names of Singh Medicos, Al-Ukba, and SP Pharma to carry out their illegal activities.

item.title: Year Ender 2025: Virat Kohli breaks multiple records; Sets new milestones for India
item.description: In 2025, Virat Kohli dominated One-Day International (ODI) cricket, setting multiple records and achieving historic milestones. He scored 651 runs in 13 ODIs with three centuries and four fifties, became the fastest to 14,000 international runs, and hit the fastest 82nd, 83rd, and 84th centuries.
